<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Tamil Nadu alliance rift:</strong> Congress ministers have threatened to resign from the state cabinet unless the TVK party formally endorses Rahul Gandhi as the Prime Ministerial candidate for 2029.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>BJP election strategy:</strong> The BJP has officially announced its list of nine candidates for the upcoming Rajya Sabha elections across six states.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxNaVhocTRXcTFZVHNGTHZRVEYyZXBfM0VIa0wzbUNUaGJjRS0zeEV6akpHUmxOMmhyaHRMNERTWW4td2hkMW8zcUZnR1poMllnUnJ1YjYycEZ4T052T2p6YjhRell2R1RHU0doVHo0d1AtdGE2dHBhM3dheUVwcUZtRmRDU3B6UDdKSnc?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative deadlock:</strong> The Constitutional Amendment Bill aimed at providing reservation for women in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies has failed to pass in the Lok Sabha.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxQWHdOMzZmODdtUEdmeHRBaW9NWElLUUxuWEUyOTFsRGdnbDRTdUlMVmQxeHdIN3VGVW5md3dLcnhxYnlxdEl3QldHZXpCei1veVl5UTk5TGh5WEdXYW11Y1VQLVNFdG9ZOGp4ZkxNaXNkeW5RU2ZNbHhWNU9Cb2p0VDBfUzEzT1UyeERfRXcxNjJDRy1SZlFjVWRkemJfS0ItcElOLXhR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Judicial administration:</strong> The Supreme Court Collegium, led by the Chief Justice of India, has approved a new policy facilitating the early transfer of High Court Chief Justices.</li>
  <li><strong>Export quality concerns:</strong> The government informed Parliament that Indian shrimp exports are facing rejections from the EU and US markets due to the detection of banned antibiotics.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
</ul>
